_hotlinesNote: All six are real, from the LGU's official 'Calatrava Hotlines' infographic (supplied 2026-09-10). Office names follow that infographic so they match the printed/posted version residents see. Ordered by urgency rather than the poster's layout. Anything without a real number must be left blank — services.html renders a blank as a non-clickable pending row instead of a dead tel: link.
